sloka: विमलेन्दुसमं वक्त्रमहो राजसि मन्थरे ।जघनं तव निर्घुष्टं रशनादामशोभितम् ॥२-९-४३॥
transliteration: vimalendusamaṁ vaktramaho rājasi manthare ।jaghanaṁ tava nirghuṣṭaṁ raśanādāmaśobhitam ॥2-9-43॥

translations.english: Your hips, glitter with the jingling girdle. Strong are the calfs of your legs and long are your feet.
